rows.label: tlk42100141_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Long before Vandham-san became a
mercenary, he was in Fons Maim.

rows.label: tlk42100141_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Vandham is an alias. His real name is
Aquila Barone Sol Esteriore.

rows.label: tlk42100141_03_msg0003
rows.name:
He was a big shot from the Barone
family, one of Invidia's noble houses.

rows.label: tlk42100141_03_msg0004
rows.name:
By the way, Vandham-san took
his name from a famous person he
admired when he was little.

rows.label: tlk42100141_03_msg0005
rows.name:
How do I know so much? I happened
to overhear it back when Vandham-san
was still hale and hearty.
